title: A grey mullet enzyme displaying both lipase and phospholipase activities: purification and characterization.
text_summary: 本研究从金灰鲈鱼内脏中分离纯化了一种具有酯酶和磷脂酶活性的酶，命名为灰鲈消化酯酶（GmDL）。通过硫酸铵沉淀、凝胶过滤、阴离子和阳离子交换层析等步骤，将GmDL纯化至均一性。纯化的GmDL分子量为约35 kDa，为单聚体。GmDL具有酯酶和磷脂酶活性，且在pH 8和50℃下，以三丁酸甘油酯、橄榄油乳液或磷脂酰胆碱为底物时，其比活力分别为64 U/mg、55 U/mg和63 U/mg。GmDL是一种热活性酶，与其他鱼类酯酶相比，其在高盐浓度下仍具有活性。此外，GmDL的N端序列与已知酯酶序列无相似性，表明其可能属于一个新的酯酶家族。

 on
 the
 rate
 of
 hydroly-
sis
 of

 oil
 by

 was
 studied

 5A).

 digestive
lipase
 [6], GmDL
 did
 not
 require
 the
 presence
 of

 display
its

 activity.

 property
 is
 in
 contrast
 with
 that
of
 bovine
 and
 porcine
 pancreatic
 lipases
 [43,44], or
 lipases
 of

major
 [25], Chinook
 salmon
 (Oncorhynchus
 tshawytscha)

(Macruronus
 novaezelandiae) [7]

 activities

 on
calcium

 emulsion
 as

 using
 PC
 as

 activity

observed

 of

 the

 of

ions
 chelators

 or

 of

speciﬁc

 U/mg)

8
 mM CaCl2 (Fig.

 of

lipase

conformation

 GmDL
Little

activity.

 of

 concen-
trations

high

 the

centrations

 Conclusion
This
 paper
 reported
 the
 puriﬁcation
 of
 a
 lipase

 a

golden
 grey

 is

 ﬁrst
 time.
 The
 pure
enzyme,
 tentatively
 named

 mullet
 digestive
 lipase
 (GmDL),
is
 a
 monomer
 with
 a
 molecular
 mass
 of

 kDa.
 GmDL
 has
 a
 wide
spectrum
 of

long-chain

 and

Unlike
 the

 digestive
 lipases
 while

 at

 GmDL
displayed
 its

 short-chain

rols
 and
 phospholipids
 at

 GmDL

 to
 the
presence
 of

 NH2-terminal

of

appears

 of
